# Switch NX2 - read when the Eglantine GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eglantine\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eglantine/nx2_switches.txt; in a portable build user\nx2_switches.txt, or
# user/config/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Every line below is off: with no switch set the emulator runs on the baseline settings, which
# are the settings every game is tested on (docs/baseline.md). A switch you add is a deviation
# from the baseline. Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Switches that are already on by default; listed only to turn them off ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread. On by default; 0 turns it off.
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=0

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes. On by default;
# 0 releases one fence at a time.
#EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=0

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# buffers the CPU never touches, which adds mutex contention and lowers FPS (upstream reported a
# large drop; not measured in this fork).
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# --- Speed experiments (0.4) ---
# These switches are off by default and unmeasured until the 0.4 release table. Each is read once
# when it is first needed. Values: 1 turns it on; unset or any other value leaves it off.

# Windows only. The front and back GPU threads of the split each get a physical performance core of
# their own and the emulated CPU cores keep off those two. Skipped, with one log line, on CPUs with
# too few physical performance cores and with EDEN_HYBRID_CORES=0.
#EDEN_NX2_PIN_GPU_THREADS=1

# Vulkan. A fence flush skips its queue submit when nothing was recorded since the last submit
# (compare "submits by origin: fence" in the EDEN_NX2_GPU_PROFILE log line).
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_EMPTY_FLUSH=1

# Windows only, multicore CPU emulation. The host timer thread (it delivers the guest's timed events,
# vsync among them) waits on a high resolution waitable timer instead of a wait that follows the
# Windows timer resolution. Windows 10 1803 or later.
#EDEN_NX2_HIRES_TIMER=1

# Vulkan. The GPU ASTC to BC transcode records the decode and the encode in one queue submit instead
# of submitting after the decode. Only has an effect where ASTC is transcoded on the GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_ASTC_ONE_SUBMIT=1

# The GPU front/back thread split also runs at GPU accuracy High and with safe DMA (otherwise it only
# runs below High); the back writes out what the caches hold of a command list before the front
# reads it. Weaker than a plain High: watch buffer-fed effects such as the sky.
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_AT_HIGH=1

# Windows only. A background thread takes guest memory pages that hold only zeros out of the process
# working set (the contents stay; a write brings the page back), so a PC low on RAM pages less. The
# log line "Trimmed ... MiB of all-zero guest pages" shows what it did.
#EDEN_NX2_ZERO_PAGE_TRIM=1

# Windows only. Changing the protection of guest memory (the GPU caches' write traps) first tries the
# range without the lock that map and unmap hold, and takes the lock only when the range is not inside
# one mapped view (EDEN_NX2_PROTECT_STATS=1 logs the protection calls).
#EDEN_NX2_PROTECT_NO_LOCK=1

# The shader precache build also reads the add-on packages of a .nup (Xenoblade Chronicles 2 Switch 2
# Edition keeps its game data there). Rebuild the precache after changing it.
#EDEN_NX2_WARM_ADDON=1

# The Vulkan GPU ASTC decoder does its per-block set-up once per block instead of once per texel (same
# results), and the opaque-ASTC scan reads the guest data in place when it is in one piece.
#EDEN_NX2_ASTC_CHEAP_UPLOAD=1

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can lower FPS: upstream reported a
# drop in Mario Kart World; not measured in this fork).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

# EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH is kept from upstream's file; this fork's source does not read it.
#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# --- Test switches (for unattended-run tests; never set these in normal use) ---
# Crash the emulator on purpose after N presented frames (a null write on the thread that presents).
# Used to test that a crash during a scripted run (eden-cli --report ...) leaves a report with
# exit.reason "host_crash" and the process exit code 73. Off unless set.
#EDEN_NX2_TEST_CRASH_AFTER_FRAMES=300
